verses.en: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.
verses.pt: Ouve, pois, as minhas palavras, ó Jó, e dá ouvidos a todas as minhas declaraçoes.
verses.en_web: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
verses.en_bbe: And now, O Job, give ear to my words, and take note of all I say.

verses.en: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.
verses.pt: Eis que já abri a minha boca; já falou a minha língua debaixo do meu paladar.
verses.en_web: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.
verses.en_bbe: See, now my mouth is open, my tongue gives out words.

verses.en: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.
verses.pt: As minhas palavras declaram a integridade do meu coração, e os meus lábios falam com sinceridade o que sabem.
verses.en_web: My words shall utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they shall speak sincerely.
verses.en_bbe: My heart is overflowing with knowledge, my lips say what is true.

verses.en: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
verses.pt: O Espírito de Deus me fez, e o sopro do Todo-Poderoso me dá vida.
verses.en_web: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
verses.en_bbe: The spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Ruler of all gives me life.

verses.en: If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.
verses.pt: Se podes, responde-me; põe as tuas palavras em ordem diante de mim; apresenta-te.
verses.en_web: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
verses.en_bbe: If you are able, give me an answer; put your cause in order, and come forward.

verses.en: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God’s stead: I also am formed out of the clay.
verses.pt: Eis que diante de Deus sou o que tu és; eu também fui formado do barro.
verses.en_web: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.
verses.en_bbe: See, I am the same as you are in the eyes of God; I was cut off from the same bit of wet earth.

verses.en: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.
verses.pt: Eis que não te perturbará nenhum medo de mim, nem será pesada sobre ti a minha mão.
verses.en_web: Behold, my terror shall not make you afraid, neither shall my pressure be heavy on you.
verses.en_bbe: Fear of me will not overcome you, and my hand will not be hard on you.

verses.en: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,
verses.pt: Na verdade tu falaste aos meus ouvidos, e eu ouvi a voz das tuas palavras. Dizias:
verses.en_web: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
verses.en_bbe: But you said in my hearing, and your voice came to my ears:

verses.en: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.
verses.pt: Limpo estou, sem transgressão; puro sou, e não há em mim iniqüidade.
verses.en_web: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.
verses.en_bbe: I am clean, without sin; I am washed, and there is no evil in me:

verses.en: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,
verses.pt: Eis que Deus procura motivos de inimizade contra mim, e me considera como o seu inimigo.
verses.en_web: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.
verses.en_bbe: See, he is looking for something against me; in his eyes I am as one of his haters;

verses.en: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.
verses.pt: Põe no tronco os meus pés, e observa todas as minhas veredas.
verses.en_web: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’
verses.en_bbe: He puts chains on my feet; he is watching all my ways.

verses.en: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.
verses.pt: Eis que nisso não tens razão; eu te responderei; porque Deus e maior do que o homem.
verses.en_web: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, in saying this you are wrong; for God is greater than man.

verses.en: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.
verses.pt: Por que razão contendes com ele por não dar conta dos seus atos?
verses.en_web: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?
verses.en_bbe: Why do you put forward your cause against him, saying, He gives no answer to any of my words?

verses.en: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.
verses.pt: Pois Deus fala de um modo, e ainda de outro se o homem não lhe atende.
verses.en_web: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.
verses.en_bbe: For God gives his word in one way, even in two, and man is not conscious of it:

verses.en: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;
verses.pt: Em sonho ou em visão de noite, quando cai sono profundo sobre os homens, quando adormecem na cama;
verses.en_web: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed;
verses.en_bbe: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep comes on men, while they take their rest on their beds;

verses.en: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,
verses.pt: então abre os ouvidos dos homens, e os atemoriza com avisos,
verses.en_web: Then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
verses.en_bbe: Then he makes his secrets clear to men, so that they are full of fear at what they see;

verses.en: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
verses.pt: para apartar o homem do seu desígnio, e esconder do homem a soberba;
verses.en_web: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
verses.en_bbe: In order that man may be turned from his evil works, and that pride may be taken away from him;

verses.en: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
verses.pt: para reter a sua alma da cova, e a sua vida de passar pela espada.
verses.en_web: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
verses.en_bbe: To keep back his soul from the underworld, and his life from destruction.

verses.en: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:
verses.pt: Também é castigado na sua cama com dores, e com incessante contenda nos seus ossos;
verses.en_web: He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones;
verses.en_bbe: Pain is sent on him as a punishment, while he is on his bed; there is no end to the trouble in his bones;

verses.en: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.
verses.pt: de modo que a sua vida abomina o pão, e a sua alma a comida apetecível.
verses.en_web: So that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.
verses.en_bbe: He has no desire for food, and his soul is turned away from delicate meat;

verses.en: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.
verses.pt: Consome-se a sua carne, de maneira que desaparece, e os seus ossos, que não se viam, agora aparecem.
verses.en_web: His flesh is so consumed away, that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.
verses.en_bbe: His flesh is so wasted away, that it may not be seen, and his bones. ...

verses.en: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.
verses.pt: A sua alma se vai chegando à cova, e a sua vida aos que trazem a morte.
verses.en_web: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.
verses.en_bbe: And his soul comes near to the underworld, and his life to the angels of death.

verses.en: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:
verses.pt: Se com ele, pois, houver um anjo, um intérprete, um entre mil, para declarar ao homem o que lhe é justo,
verses.en_web: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him;
verses.en_bbe: If now there may be an angel sent to him, one of the thousands which there are to be between him and God, and to make clear to man what is right for him;

verses.en: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.
verses.pt: então terá compaixão dele, e lhe dirá: Livra-o, para que não desça à cova; já achei resgate.
verses.en_web: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’
verses.en_bbe: And if he has mercy on him, and says, Let him not go down to the underworld, I have given the price for his life:

verses.en: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s: he shall return to the days of his youth:
verses.pt: Sua carne se reverdecerá mais do que na sua infância; e ele tornará aos dias da sua juventude.
verses.en_web: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.
verses.en_bbe: Then his flesh becomes young again, and he comes back to the days of his early strength;

verses.en: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.
verses.pt: Deveras orará a Deus, que lhe será propício, e o fará ver a sua face com júbilo, e restituirá ao homem a sua justiça.
verses.en_web: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: He makes his prayer to God, and he has mercy on him; he sees God's face with cries of joy; he gives news of his righteousness to men;

verses.en: He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;
verses.pt: Cantará diante dos homens, e dirá: Pequei, e perverti o direito, o que de nada me aproveitou.
verses.en_web: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
verses.en_bbe: He makes a song, saying, I did wrong, turning from the straight way, but he did not give me the reward of my sin.

verses.en: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.
verses.pt: Mas Deus livrou a minha alma de ir para a cova, e a minha vida verá a luz.
verses.en_web: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life shall see the light.’
verses.en_bbe: He kept my soul from the underworld, and my life sees the light in full measure.

verses.en: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,
verses.pt: Eis que tudo isto Deus faz duas e três vezes para com o homem,
verses.en_web: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,
verses.en_bbe: Truly, God does all these things to man, twice and three times,

verses.en: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.
verses.pt: para reconduzir a sua alma da cova, a fim de que seja iluminado com a luz dos viventes.
verses.en_web: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.
verses.en_bbe: Keeping back his soul from the underworld, so that he may see the light of life.

verses.en: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.
verses.pt: Escuta, pois, ó Jó, ouve-me; cala-te, e eu falarei.
verses.en_web: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.
verses.en_bbe: Take note O Job, give ear to me; keep quiet, while I say what is in my mind.

verses.en: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.
verses.pt: Se tens alguma coisa que dizer, responde-me; fala, porque desejo justificar-te.
verses.en_web: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.
verses.en_bbe: If you have anything to say, give me an answer; for it is my desire that you may be judged free from sin.

verses.en: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.
verses.pt: Se não, escuta-me tu; cala-te, e ensinar-te-ei a sabedoria.
verses.en_web: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
verses.en_bbe: If not, give attention to me, and keep quiet, and I will give you wisdom.
